title: UniVBench: Towards Unified Evaluation for Video Foundation Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the cinematic and technical performance of video foundation models, such as camera motion, lighting, and subject consistency. While it includes checks for 'IP & Privacy Compliance' and 'no harmful content' in its evaluation prompts, it does not evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a core component of its benchmarking framework.
